nextqa_selection.policy: lexicographically first two video IDs in existing 200-video selection; all original questions; no label filtering

scope: Synthetic fixtures are authored integration tests, not benchmark accuracy
NExT-QA is a two-video pilot with original labels, not full benchmark or public-download reproduction
HF and vLLM retain their native processors and numerical paths; cross-backend scores are not required to match
HF and vLLM cache checks are within each backend; vLLM can reuse full repeated-request blocks, not only media prefix
Archived reports record tested source hashes; subsequent documentation and worker-bootstrap fixes are not retroactively attributed to those earlier runs

cache_repeat_validation.final_nonfinite_guard: CPU replay of all saved results and injected NaN rejection; no model behavior change
